_doc: EFFECTIVE PRODUCTION RUNTIME CONFIG. ⛔ THIS, NOT render.yaml, is the authority. A deployment manifest is not the authority for runtime configuration: it omits dashboard-defined variables and can disagree with the running service. Discovered 2026-08-31 -- render.yaml said TURN_COORDINATOR_MODE=new_observe while production ran new_execute, and THREE eligibility flags were absent from the manifest entirely, so pin_config had never compared them and reported a clean pin.
_provenance_doc: `health` = read from the running service. `attested` = a human confirmed it from the dashboard; /health does not expose it. A measurement-critical key with NEITHER is a REFUSAL, never a None quietly recorded.

FOOD_GATE_MODEL.note: not exposed by /health. Danny confirmed from the dashboard 2026-08-27.

DEFAULT_MODEL.note: not exposed by /health; render.yaml declares it and no dashboard override is known. ⚠ WEAKEST provenance here -- re-attest if a model-sensitive conclusion depends on it.
